ideas.title: Uncovering the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the $11 million Medicaid scheme and identify other potential suspects
ideas.insight: The suspect's failure to appear in court and forfeit bond raises concerns about the effectiveness of the justice system in combating Medicaid fraud. Further investigation is needed to uncover the extent of the scheme and identify other potential suspects.
